about: A StackChan: a small M5Stack desktop robot that sits on a desk near the person. Its face is a 2-inch, 320x240 touch screen showing Impo's avatar, on a body whose head turns left and right (yaw -120 to 120 degrees, negative to its left) and tilts up (pitch 0 straight ahead to 85 looking up). It has a speaker and microphones (the person holds the power button to talk to it, and its replies are spoken), a camera under the screen that looks where the head points, a touch strip along the top of its head, a motion sensor in its head, and 12 coloured LEDs in its body. It moves, lights up and shows things only when a command tells it to.

commands.name: avatar.cheer
commands.description: Make the face on the screen cheer for a moment.

commands.name: camera.capture
commands.description: Take one photo with the camera under the robot's screen of whatever its head faces, as a 320x240 JPEG. Returned only when this command is explicitly invoked.

commands.name: display.draw_url
commands.description: Show an image from a public http(s) URL on the robot's 320x240 screen, in place of the face: a baseline JPEG, shrunk 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 as needed to fit and centred, or raw RGB565 (high byte first) in whole screen-width rows. It stays until display.show_animation brings the face back. Answers once it is drawn.

url.description: A direct link to the image itself.

row.description: The screen row the image starts at; a JPEG is centred when left out.

scale.description: 1, 2, 4 or 8: how much it was shrunk.

ms.description: How long downloading and drawing took.

commands.name: display.show_animation
commands.description: Bring the face back on the robot's screen, in place of an image display.draw_url showed.

commands.name: display.show_text
commands.description: Show a short caption on the robot's screen, for something the person wants written down. It stays until the next thing the robot shows.

commands.name: head.move
commands.description: Point the robot's head: yaw, pitch or both; what is left out stays. Answers once it has settled, with the yaw and pitch the servos measured; not_reached when it stopped more than 5 degrees short; servos_silent when they do not answer even after the robot power-cycles them. speed 150 (a natural look) if left out.

yaw.description: Degrees: 0 straight ahead, negative to the robot's left.

pitch.description: Degrees: 0 straight ahead, up to 85 looking up.

yaw.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

pitch.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

servos_revived.description: The servos had stopped answering and were power-cycled.

commands.name: head.play
commands.description: Play head frames you compose: each frame sends the head to its yaw and/or pitch and lasts ms (80 to 3000; 20 s in all). Use it for nods, shakes and dances. Answers once the head rests, with reached (per frame, the angles measured as it ended; null where the servos did not answer, common while moving) and rest; not_reached when the rest is more than 5 degrees from where the last frames sent each axis. speed 700 if left out.

yaw.description: Degrees: 0 straight ahead, negative to the robot's left.

pitch.description: Degrees: 0 straight ahead, up to 85 looking up.

yaw.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

pitch.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

items.description: null where the servos did not answer.

yaw.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

pitch.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

servos_revived.description: The servos had stopped answering and were power-cycled.

commands.name: head.status
commands.description: Where the head points now, as the servos measure it (yaw and pitch in degrees; servos_silent when they do not answer), whether it is moving, and whether the servos are holding it.

yaw.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

pitch.description: Degrees, as the servos measured it.

servos_revived.description: The servos had stopped answering and were power-cycled.

commands.name: head.stop
commands.description: Stop the head where it is; a head.move or head.play under way answers stopped.

commands.name: imu.read
commands.description: Which way up the robot's head is (upright, upside_down, face_up, face_down, on_left_side, on_right_side or tilted), whether it is moving, and the raw accelerometer (g) and gyroscope (degrees per second) readings.

commands.name: lights.off
commands.description: Turn off the LEDs in the robot's body.

commands.name: lights.set
commands.description: Light the 12 LEDs in the robot's body in one colour. They stay on until changed or turned off.

color.description: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, pink, white, warm, or #rrggbb.

commands.name: speaker.play
commands.description: Play a sound prepared for this robot on its gateway, by the id it was given there: the robot fetches it over its own connection and plays it, up to 110 seconds. Answers once it has finished playing (played_ms), or why it did not play.

id.description: The id of the prepared sound.

commands.name: speaker.play_url
commands.description: Play a sound file from a public http(s) URL: an MP3 or a 16-bit PCM WAV, up to 110 seconds. Answers once it has finished playing (played_ms), or why it did not play.

url.description: A direct link to the file itself.

commands.name: speaker.status
commands.description: What the speaker is doing now (idle, fetching, playing, or failed and why), the last URL it played, the volume and whether the speaker is on.

commands.name: speaker.stop
commands.description: Stop what the speaker is playing; a speaker.play or speaker.play_url under way answers stopped.

events.name: head_touched
events.description: The person touched the top of the robot's head and let go: how is pat (a touch) or stroke (a hand moved along the head). The robot does nothing by itself. Sent at most every 5 seconds.

how.description: pat: a touch; stroke: a hand moved along the head.

events.name: shaken
events.description: Someone shook the robot's head: peak_g is the strongest jolt in g, strength gentle or hard. The robot does nothing by itself. At most every 8 s.
